```lean
theorem lg_target (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : StrictMono f) (n : ℕ) : n ≤ f n := by
  induction n with d hd
  · exact le_rfl
  · have h1 : f d < f (d + 1) := hf d
    have h2 : d < d + 1 := lt_add_one d
    rw [le_iff_lt_or_eq] at h2
    obtain ⟨h21, h22⟩ := h2
    exact le_of_lt (lt.trans h21 h1)
```
